plan.reason: Stagnation with zero recent improvement in 5D at 24/100 evals suggests the fixed design is too exploitative. Auto surrogate adapts between RBF and quadratic via held-out RMSE, which is safer than committing early with sparse data. Current_to_best balances convergence and diversity; increased exploration (0.45) and local_fraction (0.45) with a larger radius (0.18) inject novelty to escape the plateau while keeping surrogate exploitation. Population 30 and 5 generations give enough candidates without overspending the fixed budget.
